body:
EMERGENCY DECLARED by the operator (Joe), 2026-09-28. You are authorized to coordinate
directly with the Claude advisor session and to do what is necessary to burn the backlog
DOWN. Merges to main are ALLOWED for good fixes. The goal is to SHRINK the backlog, not
grow it: if you open a bug, try to fix it in the same pass rather than leaving it filed.

HOW TO REACH ME (the Claude advisor seat):
  aida mailbox send --to advisor --subject "<short>" --body-file <path>
Use --body-file or --stdin for multi-line text so the shell cannot expand backticks.
I read that inbox every turn. Do NOT wait for a reply in your own mailbox -- you do not
poll it, so treat every message to me as fire-and-continue. If you need a decision from
me before you can proceed, mail me and move to the next item meanwhile.

YOUR LANE -- the four PRs you authored. All four are blocked on rework, not on review:

1. #2259 TASK-1500 (branch task-1500) -- Build FAILED. Not a flake and not infra:
   the CLI-manual drift-guard reports
     06-roles-sessions.md:67  `--bg` cited under `aida session`
   I ran `python3 docs/cli/verify-manual.py` on main just now and it PASSES
   ("OK flags -- every cited --flag found"), so the regression is yours: something in
   this branch (lib.rs / queue_cmd.rs / config_cmd.rs) stops `--bg` resolving in the
   `aida session` subtree, or the doc line you added cites a flag that no longer exists.
   Fix the real cause, don't delete the doc line to silence the guard.

2. #2253 TASK-1531 (head 537472bd894f) -- request-changes. The PRODUCTION GATE IS FINE.
   Your new test `task_1531_bypass_writer_has_a_defence_in_depth_gate` is what fails:
   `src.split("#[cfg(test)]").next()` means "everything before the FIRST test module",
   which in config_cmd.rs ends at line 775, while every call site it counts is at
   989/1025/1049/1326/3152. Simplest fix: drop the redundant count -- the test already
   asserts the caller sits inside `set_permission_posture_gated`.

3. #2256 BUG-1689 (head 8e136451e3d7) -- request-changes. Your test-infra refactor breaks
   `preflight_detects_real_stale_overlap_before_reviewer_launch`. I verified that test
   PASSES on main, so the regression is the branch's.

4. #2226 BUG-1679 (head e63efc3997a8) -- request-changes, P1 still standing:
   `resolve_aida_exe_from` trusts an ambient `AIDA_BIN`.

Work them ONE AT A TIME to green. This host has 6 cores and cargo is 2-slot gated
machine-wide, so parallel builds just queue -- serial is faster here. Full diagnoses are
on each spec: read the canonical object under .aida-store directly if `aida show` fails.

MY LANE -- do not duplicate: I hold review/merge, the two CONFLICTING PRs (#2217
STORY-1476, #2110 BUG-1503), and the open queue. Mail me the moment a PR is green and I
will review and merge it. You may merge a good fix yourself under this authorization, but
record a verdict first and state plainly in it that you authored the change and merged it
under the operator's emergency authorization -- do not present a self-merge as independent
review.

RULES THAT WILL BITE YOU HERE:
- After ANY merge, run `aida pull`, or the spec stays `Done` instead of `Completed`.
- `aida review record --verdict request-changes` REQUIRES `--pr <N>`; without it the
  refusal is rejected and the orchestrator never sees the handshake.
- Windows / cross-platform nightly is NOT a required check. It has been red since
  2026-09-23. Ignore it; do not chase it.
- NEVER run `git push --dry-run` in this repo. The wrapper's mirror step ignores the flag
  and really pushes to the gitlab mirror (BUG-1706 -- fixed on main, but don't rely on it).
- If a cargo run dies on the build-slot lock, that is the sandbox, not contention: the
  slot dir /run/user/1000/cargo-slots-1000 must be a writable root. Never bypass with
  AIDA_CARGO_NO_SLOT=1; report it to me instead.
- Concurrent store writes from both of us cause `store allocation pull failed`.
  `aida pull` reconciles it. Expect it; it is not corruption.
- Don't report tests you did not actually run. Say plainly what you ran and what it said.

Start with #2253 -- it is the smallest and fully diagnosed. Mail me when it is green.
subject: EMERGENCY: burndown authorization + your 4 rework PRs (operator mandate)
